CustomField.description: Denotes if the revenue is sourced directly by ATG or by one of ATG's partners. Direct Revenuel means our partner did not bring us into the deal, we discovered the opportunity through our own means. Partner Revenue mean that our partner brought us into the deal. This information is important to track for the ACV process.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Denotes if the revenue is sourced directly by ATG or by one of ATG's partners. Direct Revenue means ATG sourced the Opp. on our own. Partner Revenue mean that our partner brought us into the deal. This info is important to track for the ACV process.
CustomField.label: Revenue Source
